lines.1: The muggy heat hit us the moment we stepped out of the air-conditioned theater.
lines.3: 「You were pretty lukewarm on action movies before.」
lines.4: 「It was great that there wasn't any wire action! And it had just the right amount of romance.」
lines.5: Konoe was in a great mood.
lines.6: The other day, when we went to see a romance movie together, it was so intense that it only made things awkward.
lines.7: Maybe something light like this was better when we'd only just started dating.
lines.9: It was 29 degrees... No wonder it was hot.
lines.10: The cicadas were buzzing away too.
lines.12: 「Too bad peanut-butter syrup isn't a thing.」
lines.13: 「What drives you to peanut butter with such fervor?」
lines.14: 「I don't know, but something about wearing my hair like this makes me crave it.」
lines.15: Maybe the twintails themselves were demanding nourishment.
lines.20: 「Well, well, Tsushima-kun. Out with a cute girl? Must be nice.」
lines.33: 「But that's funny. Didn't you say you hated Tsushima-kun, Nao-chan?」
lines.34: 「Yeah... I did back then, in the first term.」
lines.35: 「Then he managed to win me over, I guess.」
lines.36: 「Oh... He won you over awfully fast. You must fall for people pretty easily, Nao-chan.」
lines.37: 「N-no, that's not it. Um... I guess I'd kind of liked him already...」
lines.38: 「I'm not really following. You used to hate him, didn't you?」
lines.40: Konoe was weak when it came to romance too.
lines.41: She was blushing and completely flustered.
